prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production game facial overlay sprite sheet with genuine alpha transparency.
Image1 is the existing Wili eye style reference, Image2 is the right-facing head to fit. Draw ONLY FOUR isolated SINGLE-EYE expression sprites, in an evenly spaced TWO-by-TWO grid. No eye pairs anywhere. Each cell contains one visible eye seen in SIDE PROFILE, looking toward the RIGHT edge of the canvas; pupil and icy iris are always toward the RIGHT side of the eye, never to the left. The head faces right, the nose would be beyond the right corner; do not draw the nose.
Top-left: alert focused right-facing side eye, slightly narrowed sharp upper lid, modest dark brow. Horizontal foreshortening, narrower than a frontal eye. Wide end of eyelid toward left, sharp anterior corner toward RIGHT.
Top-right: same side eye relaxed/half-lidded with brow raised subtly, same right-facing anatomy.
Bottom-left: same side eye nearly closed in a blink, thin slit with small iris hint at right.
Bottom-right: same right-facing side eye widened mildly in surprise, raised brow, pupil still at the right.
Keep each overlay compact and easy to read in a Don't Starve cutout rig: bold black hand-inked contour, opaque ivory sclera, restrained slate-blue gray iris, no glowing effects or gradients in background. Four cells evenly centered with ample transparent gutters. No skin, hair, head, mask, nose marks, mouth, ears, head outlines, extra strokes, labels, text or grid. Consistent precise RIGHT-FACING profile, do not mirror any cell left. Only single-eye/brow overlays; transparent everywhere else.
